additional_info.subject: RE: ID0403234-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R3 170001603] IMD_BC1 CRM:00641001008
additional_info.body:
Dear Yunus
Hope you are doing well.
Regarding the reported issue, we have reviewed the logs on the SCB and AWS server over the past month and observed a continuous IMD_BC1 Bender shoes error. This might be due to a loose connection, which needs to be checked. We recommend planning for a site intervention to ensure all the wirings are properly tightened and the settings are correct.
If the wiring and settings are fine, the Bender might be faulty and may need replacement if required.
Insulation monitering device -: 8EM5903-0AA00-0AA1
Please refer to the error descriptions captured during our observation:
